Suppose makes assumptions and review decisions inspectable. Its numerical
methods each answer a bounded question; combining their outputs does not erase
their different assumptions.

## Keep three questions separate

**Does this express the belief?** Elicitation fit checks correspondence between
stated judgments and a numerical representation. Interpretation acceptance
records a person's review of meaning.

**What follows if the assumptions hold?** Prior and posterior predictions show
consequences under a specified model. Future-measurement variation is distinct
from uncertainty about a mean.

**How does it meet observations?** Predictive checks and prospective assessments
compare model implications with measurements, subject to the collection design
and any prior exposure. None of these is a universal confidence score or proof
of a claim.

## Supported numerical families

| Workflow | Implemented method | Main boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Elicit two means | Normal quantiles fitted by least squares | Exactly two ordered numeric conditions |
| Predict a contrast | Joint normal means plus independent normal batch variation | Correlation and batch SDs are supplied |
| Update from observations | Analytic normal update | Positive known measurement SDs; independent units |
| Check a future cohort | Frozen central normal interval for a sample-mean difference | Complete designated cohort; fixed-noise model |
| Inspect sensitivity | Exact one-at-a-time prior or likelihood power scaling | Fixed-noise normal update only |
| Explore model growth | Add one shared independent normal coefficient | Prior implications, not fitting that extension |
| Fit regression | Proper normal/inverse-gamma model | One or two numeric predictors; unknown common variance |
| Compare regressions | Exact leave-one-out refits with fixed priors and transforms | Exploratory predictive comparison |
| Design a measurement | Exact expected loss reduction through alloptr | One setting per alternative; independent replicates |

## Two-condition elicitation

The prior represents two uncertain means with supplied correlation. The marginal
quantiles do not identify that correlation. Normal support can imply negative
strengths; the diagnostic reports that probability rather than truncating it.
Two anchors do not imply a monotone curve, causal effect, or behavior at other
conditions. A straight-line projection is an explicit additional assumption.

Ranges without probabilities, qualitative comparisons, and shape judgments
remain meaningful records. Unsupported judgments do not acquire numerical
probabilities merely because a model is available.

## Updating and sensitivity

The fixed-noise update treats measurement SDs as known. Paired and clustered
measurements, inferred SDs, and arbitrary likelihoods are outside that method.
Power sensitivity changes the joint prior covariance or likelihood weight.
It leaves distribution support, correlation, and physical measurement noise
specified by the original model. It is not an omnibus robustness test.

## Regression

With variance $\sigma^2$, the model uses a proper inverse-gamma prior for
$\sigma^2$ and a normal prior for coefficients conditional on that variance.
Coefficients therefore share uncertainty about scale: conditional independence
does not imply marginal independence.

Posterior fits and leave-one-out refits are exact conjugate calculations.
Only predictive checks use simulation. A better predictive score does not
establish causal meaning or adequate fit. The current implementation does not
support interactions, arbitrary formulas, or hierarchical models.

## Prospective assessment

A commitment fixes measurement IDs, source, protocol, model basis, deadline,
and predictive interval before the declared unseen outcomes are examined.
All planned outcomes are required. Incomplete data wait before the deadline
and become inconclusive afterward; exposure, timing, or protocol problems can
also prevent a numeric verdict.

An interval match does not establish claim truth or global model fit. An unseen
outcomes declaration and timestamp do not independently establish absence of
exposure. Changing a claim later does not change an earlier commitment.

## Records and provenance

Revisions preserve previous wording and numerical candidates. Retained results
refer to their particular prior, measurements, and review. Claim-to-model links
can be many-to-many; a link records a relationship to inspect, not evidence that
the model supports the claim.

Portable bundles contain data and integrity checks. They do not execute code on
load, and integrity checks do not certify truthful attribution or a valid
experimental protocol. Analyst-generated code still needs scientific review.

## Development status

The package has automated numerical, record-integrity, and UI checks, together
with synthetic and retrospective walkthroughs. Intended-scientist acceptance
remains open. The site documents current behavior; a research backlog is not a
list of shipped features.
